reviews.title: Customer service not working
reviews.text:
If your flight is on time and everything runs smoothly you will most likely never need to speak to customer service.  
But… if anything goes wrong you are not going to have any help from British Airways.  
Calling them with a complaint is not possible.   
Emailing them is not possible.  
You have to log it online.  
No one to speak to.  
My flight was rescheduled and flight class down graded. 
I asked for refund for price paid for business compared with the economy the rebooked me too.  
This flight was in July 2026. 
10 emails ( they will not help on email )
5 x 1 hour phone calls, they will / can’t help you.  
My case is closed.  No one can tell me why.  
I never got a “final response “ 
This will now have to go to the appeals process. 
But without knowing why they closed the case I can not statt the process.  
All they tell is “ you should have had a answer. Your case is closed. We don’t know why because the complaint team don’t answer phone calls “
Hope you will never need to speak to British Airways.  
Even the staff in the airport had the standard reply.  
You have to go online. Everyone has the snake answer. 
Help before check in. Go online. 
Help at check in. Go online 
Help at the gate. Go online. 
Help on board. Go online after the flight.  
Good luck all.

The responses have been “just wait”, but then I get an email that I have not given them enough info and they’re going to stop the process. Totally unprofessional. Confusing messaging. They were hacked by a Kenyan named “Jim” trying to “get the money for me”.  It’s a lot for a senior citizen to put up with. All I want is a clear explanation of their offer and they can’t seem to get that done in a timely manner. I know this isn’t an app issue. It’s an organization issue. But part of the miscommunication came through the app.

reviews.title: Constant bugs and serious technical failures
reviews.text:
The British Airways app is plagued by constant technical issues, bugs and regressions. It feels as though almost every week, another feature that previously worked suddenly stops functioning.

These aren’t minor glitches, either. Just last week, the app incorrectly informed me that my flight was disrupted and repeatedly prompted me to cancel it. I spent considerable time and money contacting BA, only to eventually be told it was a technical bug.

This week, the app is unable to generate my boarding passes, meaning I now have to make an additional trip to the airport check-in desk to collect them.

These failures have real consequences. They disrupt customers’ holidays, create unnecessary anxiety, waste time and can leave people out of pocket. This is an airline app, not a trivial piece of software. Customers depend on it for critical parts of their journeys.

As a software developer myself, I find the frequency and severity of these issues genuinely unacceptable. Bugs are inevitable, but repeatedly deploying releases into production that break existing, business-critical functionality raises serious questions about quality assurance, regression testing and release management. At any competent engineering organisation, recurring failures of this nature should trigger serious scrutiny of the release process.

Credit where it’s due: the recent redesign is an improvement over the previous app. However, the bar was exceptionally low to begin with, and a more polished interface is

I’ve tried restarting my phone, waited overnight before trying again, cleared my cache and cookies, cleared my tabs, used public wifi and mobile data, incognito, vpn, Safari and Google. I also tried selecting a peak and off peak dates. I also tried on a different phone and an ipad but it wanted to send OTP to my number but I wasn’t receiving anything and it might be because I was in another country. I’d appreciate it if OTPs can be sent via email or Whatsapp. I even asked a friend in the UK to rebook it for me, from her phone and laptop but the issue persisted. She also called BA for me but the waiting time was over half an hour at the time so we didn’t get through to anyone. 

I used the Avios Whatsapp for help but they couldn’t do anything but raise a ticket for me. So I called internationally which costed me £80+ because I also had to wait for over half an hour before a lovely agent picked up the call and helped me rebook my flight. 

It’s been resolved at a cost, when it should’ve taken 10 minutes to do and for free. I’ve been contacting Avios Whatsapp for a month now, every 10 days as they keep telling me someone will get in touch within 10 days. It’s been 31 days and nothing heard. As much as I love flying with BA, I not again. Poor customer service.

reviews.title: Demanding full access to Calendar
reviews.text: British Airways demands full access to all calendar events just to add a booking to the Calendar. This is incredibly intrusive and inappropriate. Why do they need to know about my dental appointment

reviews.title: Glitchy, annoying and horribly built
reviews.text: This app never works, its updates are a joke and it constantly forgets who u am somehow even when i am logged in. Every time you click into another section of the app it’s like it’s connecting to the internet and constantly asks if id rather use the app…while I am in the app. Make it make sense.

reviews.title: Useless app
reviews.text: Every time I go to the app it just takes me to their mobile site. Also, you cannot view or change your seat. Every time I select “manage seat” it gives me an error.

reviews.title: Calendar
reviews.text: You ask for my full calendar access instead of “add only”? What you scraping customers calendars and selling the data? Thats illegal. Fix your app so calendar is “add only”

reviews.title: Outdated technology
reviews.text: This app is super outdated despite the modern UI. For example, if your flight gets canceled and rebooked, the app doesn’t know how to deal with that and just redirects you to the mobile website. Even if your return flight isn’t impacted, it still says the trip needs attention and redirects to the website. The app is essentially useless. I’ve decided to deprioritize choosing BA going forward because of these technical issues. It’s not 2008 anymore, it’s time to catch up to basically every other airline that has a fully featured app.

reviews.title: Come on BA
reviews.text: How can you work to improve an app only to make the experience worse. How is this possible. Get your act together.

reviews.title: App is archaic
reviews.text:
This app is an embarrassment to BA. Never mind it being light years beyond airlines like delta - it’s far worse than guys like wizz air and Ryanair.

Not being able to scan an ID in app and having to show it at the airport is farcical in 2026

reviews.title: Worst airline app
reviews.text: BA needs to study what its competitors (like United) offer on equivalent apps. On the BA app (and website) I can’t easily view alternative flights, I can’t choose seats easily, lags, and if BA changes/cancels your flight then this app can’t help you one bit. Instead you’ll need to wait an hour to speak to customer service. Time for BA to do a 101 on app UI/UX design and overhaul their IT system.

reviews.title: Come On BA
reviews.text: I expect more from British Airways. Anyone giving this five stars hasn't used other decent airline apps. There's so little information!!

reviews.title: App needs updated!
reviews.text: Your app is so antiquated. Budget airlines have better apps. Can’t do hardly anything within the app. Book with points? Nope. Change a flight? Nope. Go to delta and learn what a good airline app is

reviews.title: Barely functioning
reviews.text: Couldn’t log in for the first days, can’t load boarding passes, leaves the app to load a web page for most reservation changes. Please improve this.

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: Keeps crashing. Completely useless, even after various re-installs. Please fix it!!

reviews.title: Lots of issues
reviews.text: So many features you’d expect from an airline app aren’t available. The app forces you to go to a web browser which requires you to log in. Also, the seat selector hasn’t worked for me since this new app was launched.

reviews.title: Trash. No option to book reward travel through the app. Reward flights are uniformly more expensive
reviews.text: Trash. No option to book reward travel through the app. Reward flights are uniformly more expensive when booking through BA on AA. Not impressed

reviews.title: Not a real app. Has basically zero functionality
reviews.text: Not sure why they released this, almost no functionality is actually in the app rather it’s just a shell of an app that pops you out  to the mobile browser (where you need to login again) for almost everything.  Save your time and just open safari and go to the BA website, that’s where you will end up anyways

reviews.title: New App is Terrible
reviews.text: Why would you push a release on an app that is barely functional? If you want to do ANYTHING, you have to go to the website. The old app still worked, I’m super frustrated that I updated it. Truly ridiculous. They seem to be doing the same with their website which also isn’t working properly. Couldn’t pay to add and bag or upgrade because the website kept failing. No wonder you’re in the basement of CDG like the ugly stepchild.

Spoke with customer service representative who confirmed all details are present but could not help. It’s ridiculous that in 2026 such basic functionality has glitches. Oh and that pretty little app feedback button in the app menu does not work.

reviews.title: BA interfaces not user friendly
reviews.text: I’m unable to update my seats in the app and it’s very basic information. I then get routed to the internet to change my flight information and when I go to pay the website crashes. British airways website and app are terrible.

reviews.title: Rubbish upgrade
reviews.text: Ever since the last update I can no longer access my account on third app. I have tried deleting and installing it several times to no avail. It keeps saying I’m offline when  not and when I try and my trips it says it can’t do it. Absolute rubbish!

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: It just sends you to web to actually manage your trip so what’s the point of even having an app?

reviews.title: Terrible app
reviews.text: Every single link on the app just redirects me to the BA website. Why even bother with an app?

reviews.title: Buggy
reviews.text: Better than previous builds but not quite there yet. First, it’s still exceedingly painfully slow for 2026 standards running in an iP17 Pro Max. The navigation is a bit complicated than I would expect. Simplify views and collapse everything else that are not must-knows or need-to-knows data. Simplify menus. Make it streamlined: menu item, submenu item, and so on (not a menu item that exists as submenu item, then it appears as submenu item elsewhere in a submenu. I get confused with data the app shows me and data shown in a webpage, supposedly they should be the same content. The app does not seem in synch with the website. The app shows me outdated info, even shows canceled itinerary preferentially over the active itinerary. I find myself deleting and re-installing the app to force it to synch.

reviews.title: Worst airline app I've ever used
reviews.text: This app makes it more difficult to travel.  It is glitchy on sign in in almost every country except GB.  It doesn't give you any notifications of travel needs in foreign countries.  My family of 5 was almost stuck in Brindisi trying to get to London because BA didn't make us aware we now needed to get an ETA prior to leaving Italy if we didn't have a connecting flight in London.  Sure, you could expect us to know about this new requirement but we booked these tickets over a year ago and a responsible airline would have at least notified us of this new requirement.  When we checked in online 24 hrs ahead of time you would think it might remind us we needed this document.  It only told us we needed to check with the ticket agent at the airport who said the ETA was missing and gave very little assistance on how to get one.  The app was useless for this and multiple other travel related items.  WiFi almost never works on these planes so the app is useless while flying mostly.  0 stars if that is available

reviews.title: So terrible- buggy and inefficient
reviews.text: Please check your software- in particular your mobile version.  It is riddled with bugs so much it took me 18 min to check in.  I kept refreshing and it would reset my check in status each time,  then I could not find the actual check in until I went through 8 different menus.  Also, it asks me to input my travel details before check in which it should already be in there per my complete profile and from a prior successive, connected flight on the same itinerary.  It was just awful and made me quite unsure and nervous about being able to get home.  I am now rethinking any future BA travels until you all actually get superb quality software.  Just sooooo disappointed!!!!!

reviews.title: Utter Disaster
reviews.text: How a major airline can put out an app of this poor quality is a disgrace. Completely disorganized UI, random web page loads within the app, confusing check-in, laggy bag tracking. Waste of time to fight this app.  It can’t even get status right 3 hours before a flight. One second it says you’re all set then it says you can check in. Horrendous. Never again will I book BA. Besides the pleasantries and keeping the planes in the air, these folks are utterly incompetent.  Final update, I just finished my journey. I’m picking up my baggage for good and there’s a banner notification saying I have another flight later today when in fact, it’s really the BA app utterly confused about time zones. There is a world outside GMT!!! anyone who is part of developing this app and testing this app and commissioning this app should be fired.

reviews.title: Not Functional
reviews.text: Through my years of booking with B.A. I have never had a smooth experience. Online, I can’t log in nor check my flights if I am somehow able to log on. On the application, same thing but now it won’t even open. I have been trying to move flights since February to no avail. I was unable to contact anyone as they never answered. I reset my password but never got an email from them in order to actually reset the password. Now I will have to get a different flight with a different airline because of this. When I was on the phone with them, they told me that it would be easier to do it in person at the airport. No class, no urgency, terrible airline and service.

reviews.title: Big problems with recent changes
reviews.text:
The most recent changes to the BA app and website since my last trip in February:

1. Unable to verify that my US Known Traveler ID has been input or to input it if it’s not there for a specific reservation. The recent changes only show passport numbers and have removed all references to Known Traveler IDs. Unlike with US carriers, it has also never been possible to permanently add this to my profile to eliminate the need to add it with every US originating flight. 

2.  No way to find the dedicated Gold Member phone numbers either in the app or on the website. I had to rely on non-BA travel blogs to find this information. 

3.  Recent addition of a passcode function suddenly disables the ability to log in at all. It keeps going in circles trying to use a nonfunctioning Face ID. Trying to log in using another method, seems to succeed only briefly, but then goes back to the nonfunctioning Face ID screen without actually logging me in (alternate login methods work only on a desktop, not on a mobile phone using either the app or website via browser). There is no way for a user to reset their own nonfunctioning passcode via the app or using a desktop computer.

reviews.title: Dreadful
reviews.text: I don’t think in the last few years that this app has ever worked properly. But now it is next to useless, whoever is responsible for this app should be embarrassed at the fact that very little in it works. You can very rarely load existing booking, when you try and make new booking it stops working or gets all the way to the checkout and then won’t let you purchase. Constant error message when searching for flight. Tbh the list is endless, no part of the app works as it should. BA you need to recruit someone that actually wants to deliver a working app to your customers. Oh and don’t get me started on thru g to get a boarding pass via the app. It sends you round in endless circles. Switching between app and website. The standard of this app lets Ba down in every way. How can the budget airlines have superior apps and BA not!!

reviews.title: Need a lot of work
reviews.text:
The app looks and feels like 2006 instead of 2026. 

There are numerous pages that open up in Safari instead of natively within the app. There is no quick way to add a boarding pass to the Apple wallet, as you have play around with multiple windows and clicks. There is also no widget that displays the time or the status of the flight on the lock screen or on the Dynamic Island. The watch complication is extremely basic and doesn’t update. There is no way to get a push notification for tracked flights, so you don’t know if it landed or departed, and you have to manually check and refresh, which defeats the purpose. I don’t want to be refreshing to see if the plane departed. When booking a new flights the app doesn’t load and gets stuck. It would be great to know when a flight boards. For instance, the flight is at 13:20 and boards at X time. That way you can walk to the gate a few minutes before. 

Please consider re-developing your app. You can have a look at Delta or Air India or United or Air Canada. Lots of options for an app in the age of AI and in 2026.

reviews.title: Technical Issues
reviews.text:
I have tried once a day for over a week to change my flights via ‘manage my booking’ within the app. However, I receive the message ‘sorry, we’re experiencing technical difficulties’ after selecting the new date. Before the most recent update, I was able to change flight dates quickly and easily within the app, so it appears to be a new issue. 

If an airline provides an app, it should allow customers to manage their booking efficiently. Being told the only alternative is to call, to be put on hold, to wait in a queue, then have an agent manually read out all potential flight options completely defeats the purpose of having a digital self serve platform. 

At present, the app isn’t functioning for one of its core features, which makes managing bookings unnecessarily difficult. This experience makes me reconsider using BA to book a flight again as I can’t deal with the hassle for a simple date change.

reviews.title: Worst Airline App
reviews.text:
The BA app is consistently unreliable. It often fails to refresh and doesn’t show all the flights I’ve already booked, which completely defeats the purpose of having an airline app in the first place. On top of that, it constantly throws up a vague “Sorry, we are having a problem, please try later” message, with no explanation and no fix.

What’s most frustrating is how limited the functionality is compared to other airline apps. Basic features like bag tracking are missing, and many actions simply redirect you to the web portal instead of being handled properly in the app. If I wanted to use the website, I wouldn’t have downloaded the app.

Overall, this feels like another outdated, low-cost piece of technology from what is supposed to be a premium airline. Other carriers manage modern, stable apps that actually add value. This one just adds friction — and it’s yet another reason to switch to a different airline.

reviews.title: So bad
reviews.text:
This is not a complaint about the airline. This is about the app. It crashes and signs you out all the time. It also can’t decide whether I have checked in or not. While I am sitting at the gate, the homepage changes in front of me, between ‘you can now check in for your flight’ and ‘your all set for your flight’. Not to mention that when you try to do anything, it takes you to their website running in the app. It is incredibly slow. This is not a one off, this is every time I try to use the app. I have tried the app on an iPhone XR, iPhone 13, iPhone 14 Pro Max and iPhone 15. Same on all. It is definitely not the phone.
Edit: The app has still not improved and if anything has got worse. I now keep getting signed out when I open it and on the odd occasion that it decides to stay signed in, it says I have no flights booked even when I do. There is also a new tier points system which is awful. It is now one point per pound spent and you need so many points. And for some reason I haven’t got any of those points. Since the last reset I have been on qualifying flights which it shows as qualifying but still on zero points.

reviews.title: Very unreliable
reviews.text:
When it works, it’s fine, but it is very unreliable. Nearly every time I go to check in, I have log in problems, or error messages saying that those service is not currently available. At the time of writing I am trying to check in for my fifth flight in two months and just about all of them have been problematic. The app is incapable of remembering passport details, so I have to enter the same information I gave them last week. When I am checking in 24 hours before, I don’t always have my passport with me, so why doesn’t it send a reminder notification a week before? It also seems that half the functions are not done in the native app, but through a website for which the app is merely a front. Yet there are somethings you can only do on the website, but not in the app? To be honest, many times it is more reliable to just go to the website via Safari than use the app.
UPDATE: have not been able to log in to my account for over two years now and customer services are unable to help.
